blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
blocks.zh: 仅用解码器的大型视图合成模型(LVSM)与KV-cache最近通过在不重建3D几何功能的情况下从神经网络中退缩新观点而实现了最先进的质量,而Test-Time Training(TT)层则节省了计算但牺牲质量. 我们提出Test-Time Baking(TTB),这个策略学习将全球场景信息从交叉视野的注意力烘烤成轻量级的MLP,使得快速和高真实度的小说视野解码成为可能. 第一个关键是重新使用TTT的快重MLP,从输入输出对子中明确学习交叉视图注意力映射,而不是完全取代注意力,实现与TTT相同的渲染效率,同时交付质量大大提高. 第二键处理上下文预填充和小说视图渲染之间的模式错配:我们把上下文符号分解为仅相机上下文渲染符号作为TTB输入,而上下文地面真实符号则使用图像内容作为TTB映射目标,确保烤的MLP解除上下文和小说视图处理之间的模式泛化挑战. 我们的方法可达到**23x** 使速度与若干基准的先进水平相当。 项目网页:https://test-time-baking.github.io

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Our research studies the task of novel-view synthesis conditioned on a set of context images with the powerful Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) [ 25 ] .
LVSMs have recently emerged with several immediate follow-up improvements [ 22 , 31 , 69 , 77 , 58 ] , achieving state-of-the-art novel-view synthesis quality across various input conditions [ 1 , 23 , 64 , 42 ] .
Their geometry-free scene representations and Transformer-based renderers are fully learning-based, making them favorable for scaling with increasing amounts of training data.
The minimized 3D inductive bias also shows advantages when scenes are challenging for existing Transformer-compatible geometry-based representations (e.g., 3DGS [ 29 ] ), such as surfaces with strong mirror reflections or translucent material.
blocks.zh:
我们的研究研究了小说-取景合成的任务,以一套具有强大大取景合成模型(LVSM)的上下文图像为条件[25].
最近,LVSM出现了一些即时的后续改进[22,31,69,77,58],在各种输入条件中实现了最先进的小说视角合成质量[1,23,64,42].
它们的无几何场景表现和以变形器为基础的渲染器都完全以学习为基础,使它们更有利于随着越来越多的培训数据而缩小规模。
最小的3D诱导偏差也显示出了当场景对现有变形器相容几何表达(如3DGS [29])具有挑战性时的优点,例如有强镜反射或半透明材料的表面.

blocks.en:
We are especially interested in the decoder-only variant of LVSM [ 25 ] for its high-fidelity.
DVSM [ 58 ] further introduces KV-cache to the cross-view attention layers, showing both quality and efficiency improvement.
The KV-cache serves as a global scene state for novel-view queries, but the rendering time is still impractical under dense context view conditions due to the linear complexity per token when attending to the KV-cache.
LaCT [ 77 ] takes a different approach by replacing cross-view attention layers with Test-Time Training (TTT) [ 59 ] layers, as illustrated in Fig. 2 a.
TTT performs inner-loop optimization to adapt fast-weight MLPs [ 49 ] to directly map queries to their values without the quadratic-complexity attention, which can also be interpreted as a variant of linear attention [ 36 ] .
Despite achieving constant-complexity rendering speed, TTT significantly sacrifices rendering quality.
A naive remedy for LaCT is to initialize from pretrained decoder-only model weights, which does improve quality, but the gap to the pretrained model remains significant.
blocks.zh:
我们特别感兴趣的是LVSM [25] 的解码器唯一变体,因为它具有高纯度.
DVSM [58] 进一步将KV-cache引入了交叉视图关注层,显示出质量和效率的提高.
KV-cache作为小说-视图查询的全局场景状态,但由于在前往KV-cache时每个信使的线性复杂性,在密集上下文情况下的渲染时间仍然不切实际.
LaCT [77] 采取了不同的做法,将交叉视图的注意层取而代之的是测试-时间训练 [59]层,如图2 a所说明.
TTT执行内-loop优化,以将快重的MLP [49] 直接将查询映射到它们的值上而无需四相-复杂注意,这也可以被解释为线性注意的变体 [36].
尽管实现了常复杂渲染速度,TTT还是显著地牺牲了渲染质量.
LaCT的一个天真的补救办法是从被预先训练的解码器唯一的模型重量开始初始化,这确实提高了质量,但到预先训练的模型的差距仍然很大.

blocks.en:
We argue that this quality gap can be minimized by repurposing the fast-weight MLP inner-loop optimization as “baking” the information from cross-view attention, rather than replacing cross-view attention entirely as in TTT.
We dub our strategy Test-Time Baking (TTB), illustrated in Fig. 2 b.
The key motivation is to trade context-view processing time for faster and higher-fidelity novel-view rendering, achieving the Pareto frontier of quality and speed shown in Fig. 1 .
Specifically, the inner-loop learning target becomes the output tokens from cross-view attention, instead of the raw value tokens used in TTT.
This formulation also generalizes beyond the linear-attention interpretation of TTT [ 36 ] .
In principle, the learning target of our TTB can also be tokens from arbitrarily non-linear layers or tokens enriched with additional scene information.
blocks.zh:
我们主张,通过将快速量级的MLP内出行优化重新定位为“将”来自交叉视点的信息“存储”,而不是像TTT那样完全取代交叉视点,就可以将这种质量差距降到最低。
我们用法格来描述我们的战略, (单位:千美元)
关键动机是将上下文视图处理时间进行交易,以更快、更真实地进行小说-视图渲染,实现图1所示质量和速度的帕雷托前沿。
具体来说,"内出自"学习目标成为了从交叉视图关注的输出符号,而不是TTT中使用的原始值符号.
这一提法还概括地超越了TTT[36]的线性意图解释.
原则上,我们 TTB 的学习目标也可以是任意的非线性地层的象征物,或者用额外的场景信息来充实的象征物.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we identify a modality misalignment issue inherent to the context prefilling of MLP fast-weight for novel-view synthesis.
In the reconstruction stage (context prefilling), the fast-weight MLPs are updated using context tokens with both camera and image information.
In the rendering stage, however, the updated MLPs take novel-view tokens coming from camera-only input without any image content.
This conventional pipeline poses a reconstruction-rendering input modality misalignment challenge.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们确定一个模式错配问题,这是新颖视角合成上下文预填MLP快重所固有的。
在重建阶段(context prefilling),用有相机和图像信息的上下文符号来更新快重的MLP.
然而,在渲染阶段,更新的MLP取自自相机专用输入而没有任何图像内容的小说取景符.
这种传统的管道构成重建后投入模式错位的挑战。

blocks.en:
Our solution to modality misalignment is simple yet effective.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 c, we pair each context view into i) context ground-truth tokens, derived from input cameras and images that produce the global scene information to be baked, and ii) context rendering tokens, derived from camera-only input that simulates novel-view rendering conditions.
At each TTB layer, the fast-weight MLP is optimized to map context rendering tokens to their corresponding context ground-truth tokens, which carry image and cross-view attended information.
The optimized TTB-MLP is then shared between context rendering tokens and the downstream novel-view rendering tokens for retrieving scene information, ensuring that their conditioning remains identical across all layers.
blocks.zh:
我们解决模式不协调的办法是简单而有效的。
如图2c所示,我们把每个上下文视图配为一)上下文地-真能信使,取自于生成要烘烤的全球场景信息的输入相机和图像;和 二)上下文渲染信使,取自于模拟出新颖视图渲染条件的仅相机输入.
在每个 TTB 层上,快重的 MLP 被优化,可以将上下文渲染符号映射到相应的上下文地-真实符号上,这些上下文会携带图像和交叉视图所显示的信息.
然后在上下文渲染符和下游小说-视图渲染符之间共享优化的TTB-MLP来取回场景信息,确保它们的调值在所有地层都保持不变.

blocks.en:
Interestingly, TTB draws a natural parallel with traditional implicit radiance and light field reconstruction, where MLPs are optimized to map spatial coordinates to radiance values.
In TTB, the fast-weight MLP instead is optimized to map ray-patch latent coordinates to their appearance latent representations, which effectively performs few-step light-field optimization in latent space.
This perspective suggests that TTB interpolates appearance latents for novel viewpoints from their ray-patch latent coordinates, motivating a convergence-oriented inner loop over one-shot summarization. In summary, our contributions are as follows: • We propose Test-Time Baking, which retargets the inner-loop optimization of the TTT fast-weight MLP from raw value tokens to cross-view attention outputs, so that the fast-weight MLP collaborates with attention rather than replacing it. • We identify a modality misalignment between the reconstruction and rendering stages of MLP fast-weight prefilling, and resolve it via a context pair that disentangles each context view into a ground-truth and a camera-only rendering token. • We draw a connection between TTB’s inner loop and light field optimization in latent space, which motivates a convergence-oriented training recipe (multi-step MSE) that we find particularly effective for TTB.
blocks.zh:
有趣的是,TTB绘制出与传统隐含光度和光场重建的自然平行,其中MLP被优化以将空间坐标映射到光度值.
在TTB中,快重的MLP被优化,将射线-patch潜在坐标映射到其外观下的潜在表现,这在潜在空间中有效地实现了几步轻地优化.
这种观点表明,TTB会从它们的射线-平面潜伏坐标中对新观点的外观潜入,从而在一发即成的基础上推动面向趋同的内环。 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 我们提出"Test-Time Baking",将TTT快重MLP的内放优化从生值符改为交叉取景关注输出,使快重MLP配合关注而非取而代之. ^ 我们发现MLP快速重量预填的重建阶段和渲染阶段之间的模式错配,并通过一个上下文组合解决,将每个上下文视图分解成地面真实和仅相机渲染符号。 我们在TTB的内环和潜在空间的光场优化之间建立了联系,这激励着一种面向聚合的训练秘方(多步骤的MSE),我们认为这对TTB特别有效.

blocks.en: We draw a connection between TTB’s inner loop and light field optimization in latent space, which motivates a convergence-oriented training recipe (multi-step MSE) that we find particularly effective for TTB.
blocks.zh: 我们在TTB的内环和潜在空间的光场优化之间建立了联系,这激励着一种面向聚合的训练秘方(多步骤的MSE),我们认为这对TTB特别有效.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Per-Scene optimization. Early approaches to novel-view synthesis perform per-scene optimization, fitting differentiable scene representations to observed images via differentiable rendering.
Coordinate-based MLPs [ 41 , 2 , 4 ] , voxels [ 56 , 15 , 8 , 43 , 57 , 34 ] , and the landmark 3DGS [ 29 ] as the scene representation have been widely explored.
Despite impressive quality, per-scene optimization does not scale with the increasing training scenes and degrades quickly under fewer input views.
blocks.zh:
场景优化. 小说-视觉合成的早期方法表现了每个场景的优化,通过不同的渲染将不同的场景表现相接入被观测到的图像.
基于坐标的MLP [41, 2, 4], voxels [56, 15, 8, 43, 57, 34], 地标3DGS [29] 作为场景代表的地标被广泛探索.
尽管质量令人印象深刻,但人均场景优化并没有随着培训场景的增加而扩大规模,在投入视图减少的情况下会迅速退化.

blocks.en:
Geometry-based feed-forward models. To overcome the scalability limitations and lengthy procedure of per-scene optimization, learning-based methods train networks to predict 3D representations from images.
Early works estimated multi-plane images via cost volumes [ 73 , 68 , 17 , 72 , 16 , 40 ] , while NeRF-based generalizable methods [ 7 , 74 , 67 , 37 ] extended coverage to wide-angle viewpoints at limited quality.
The advent of 3DGS [ 29 ] reframed the problem as pixel-aligned GS prediction [ 6 , 71 , 10 , 60 , 62 , 24 ] , achieving promising results, and Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) [ 21 ] further demonstrated Transformer scalability across various 3D representations [ 5 , 70 , 76 ] .
One fundamental limitation of handcrafted 3D is their degradation on surfaces or materials they are not designed for, whereas the geometry-free representations we study can learn them given data.
Furthermore, explicit 3D geometry lacks a compact latent representation, and efforts to manage their linearly growing output size under more input views [ 12 , 11 , 63 , 45 ] remain a symptom of this constraint.
Our TTB bakes scenes into constant-size MLPs at higher quality.
blocks.zh:
以几何为主的向导模型. 为了克服每个场景优化的可伸缩性限制和漫长的程序,以学习为基础的方法训练网络从图像中预测出3D表达.
早期的作品通过成本量估计出多架飞机的图像[73,68,17,72,16,40],而以NERF为基础的可通用方法[7,74,67,37]则以有限的质量将覆盖范围扩大到广角观点.
3DGS[29]的出现将问题重新描绘成像素相通的GS预测[6,71,10,60,62,24],取得了有希望的结果,而"大型重建模型"[21]进一步展示了各种三维表示的变相可扩展性[5,70,76].
手动立体的一个根本限制是它们在表面或材料上的降解,而我们研究的无几何表达可以学到这些数据。
此外,清晰的三维几何缺乏紧凑的潜在表现,在更多输入观点[12、11、63、45]下管理其线性增长的产出规模的努力仍然是这一制约因素的一个表现。
我们的TTB将场景以更高的质量烤成恒大MLP.

blocks.en:
Geometry-free feed-forward models. An alternative paradigm sidesteps the limitations of geometry-based models by representing scenes as latent representations and rendering via neural networks.
Early methods [ 13 , 55 , 54 , 53 , 46 , 47 ] were constrained by limited network capacity, while Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) [ 25 ] broke this barrier by leveraging powerful Transformers.
Encoder-decoder and decoder-only LVSM variants are explored.
The encoder-decoder LVSM [ 25 ] encodes context views into scene tokens and decodes novel views conditioned on the encoded scene, with subsequent works refining scene encoding strategies [ 22 , 31 , 69 ] and extending to generative [ 1 ] and uncalibrated camera [ 23 , 78 , 64 , 42 ] settings.
The decoder-only LVSM [ 25 ] , on the other hand, uses a single network for both context prefilling and novel-view rendering.
Despite higher fidelity, its original form inefficiently processes context views independently for each novel view.
DVSM [ 58 ] addresses this by prefilling context views into a KV-cache shared across all novel views, achieving state-of-the-art quality under both sparse and dense view settings.
However, the linearly growing KV-cache size makes rendering speed impractical for larger numbers of input views.
LaCT [ 77 ] replaces cross-view attention with Test-Time Training layers to achieve constant rendering complexity, but at a significant quality cost compared to DVSM.
Our Test-Time Baking achieves the same constant rendering complexity while substantially closing the quality gap left by LaCT.
blocks.zh:
无几何饲料前向模型. 另一种范式通过将场景作为潜伏的表示和通过神经网络的渲染,回避了以几何学为基础的模型的局限性.
早期的方法[13,55,54,53,46,47]受到有限网络容量的限制,而大视野合成模型(LVSMs)[25]通过利用强大的变形器来突破了这个障碍.
探索了编码器-解码器和解码器唯一的LVSM变体.
编码器-解码器 LVSM [25]将上下文视图编码成场景符并解码以被编码的场景为条件的新颖视图,后作完善了场景编码策略[22,31,69]并延伸至基因相机[23,78,64,42]设置.
而只有解码器的LVSM [25]则使用单一的网络进行上下文预填和小说-视图渲染.
尽管忠贞程度更高,但其原始形式低效地处理每个新颖视图的独立上下文。
DVSM [58] 解决了这个问题,将上下文视图预先填充到所有新观点共享的KV-cache中,在稀有和密集的视图环境中实现最先进的质量.
然而,线性增长的KV-cache大小使得渲染速度对更多输入视图不切实际.
LaCT [77] 以Test-Time Training地层来取代交叉视图关注,以达到恒定渲染的复杂性,但与DVSM相比质量成本相当高.
我们的测试-时间烘焙实现了相同的常态渲染复杂性,同时大大地缩小了LACT留下的质量差距.

blocks.en:
Test-time Training layers. TTT [ 59 ] has recently emerged as a popular alternative to attention for its linear time and constant space complexity.
We refer interested readers to [ 36 ] for an in-depth review and analysis.
We are particularly interested in the variant presented in LaCT [ 77 ] , which has demonstrated success in accelerating various vision and 3D tasks [ 9 , 63 , 18 , 14 , 26 ] , albeit at the cost of quality relative to their attention-based counterparts.
Our TTB departs from this paradigm in two ways: rather than replacing attention, TTB learns directly from attention outputs; and rather than performing mere token-to-token information exchange, TTB explicitly learns to map camera-ray tokens to their corresponding image tokens, yielding improved novel-view synthesis quality.
blocks.zh:
试训分层. TTT[59]最近成为人们所注意的通俗替代方法,因为它的线性时间和不断的空间复杂性.
我们请感兴趣的读者参看[36],以便深入审查和分析。
我们特别感兴趣的是LACT[77]提出的变体,该变体证明在加速各种远景和立体任务[9、63、18、14、26]方面取得了成功,尽管相对于关注的对应方而言,其质量代价是质量。
我们的TTB在两个方面背离了这个范式:TTB不是取代注意力,而是直接从注意力输出中学习;以及TTB不是只进行象征性的对接信息交换,而是明确学习将相机射线符号映射到相应的图像符号上,从而产生更好的小说视角合成质量.

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Pipeline. Our model stacks L L identical blocks of Intra-view Attention, FFN, Test-Time Baking, and FFN. In the reconstruction stage, each context view is duplicated into a context pair, where the context ground-truth token X ( ctx-gt ) X^{(\text{ctx-gt})} carries RGB and pose while the context rendering token X ( ctx-rend ) X^{(\text{ctx-rend})} is pose-only and matches the modality of the novel rendering token X ( nv ) X^{(\text{nv})} . At each TTB layer, the inner-loop update bakes the fast-weight MLP via MSE loss to map X ( ctx-rend ) X^{(\text{ctx-rend})} toward the cross-view attention output of X ( ctx-gt ) X^{(\text{ctx-gt})} .
The baked MLP is applied to serve three token streams: it propagates both X ( ctx-rend ) X^{(\text{ctx-rend})} and X ( nv ) X^{(\text{nv})} to the next layer, and provides feedback to X ( ctx-gt ) X^{(\text{ctx-gt})} as an auxiliary signal. In the novel-view rendering stage, each token retrieves global scene information in O ⁡ ( 1 ) O(1) from the baked MLP, instead of O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) via cross-attention. blocks.en: 3.3 Test-time Baking
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 试烧时间

blocks.en:
We present our technical contribution to improve the rendering-time efficiency of DVSM [ 58 ] while retaining its high rendering quality.
The issue of DVSM is that its KV-cache size grows linearly with the number of context tokens, making it slow and impractical for novel-view queries under high-resolution or dense input context views.
A naive strategy is to replace each CrossAttn ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \mathrm{CrossAttn}(\cdot) in Eq. 3 with a Test-Time Training (TTT) [ 59 ] layer, achieving constant space and linear time complexity as demonstrated in LaCT [ 77 ] .
However, we observe significant quality degradation even when finetuning the TTT variant from DVSM pretrained weights.
This motivates us to explore a better solution that improves upon TTT.
A full model pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 3 .

一个天真的策略是将 Eq. 3 中的 CrossAttn 每一个 CrossAttn ()\mathrm{CrossAttn} (\cdot) 替换为测试-时间训练 (TTT) [59] 层,实现LACT [77] 所显示的恒定空间和线性时间复杂性.
然而,我们观察到,即使在从DVSM预先受限重量中微调TTT变体时,质量也明显退化.
这促使我们探索一个更好的解决办法,改进贸易、技术和贸易安排。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Repurposing TTT: collaborating instead of replacing attention
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 重用TTT:合作而不是取而代之

blocks.en:
Our motivation is to trade reconstruction (prefilling) computation, which only needs to be performed once per scene, for improved rendering-time speed and quality.
The resulting solution is simple yet effective.
Rather than entirely replacing cross-view attention with TTT fast-weight MLP as in the LaCT [ 77 ] , we repurpose TTT to explicitly learn from the input-output pairs out of cross-view attention.
Consequently, we no longer need to cache the KV; only the updated MLP fast weights are stored.
The space and time complexity of novel-view rendering is therefore identical to that of TTT.
We call our strategy Test-Time Baking (TTB), which can be viewed as a generalized form of TTT.

我们的动机是进行重建(预补)计算,每个场景只需进行一次计算,以提高渲染速度和质量。
由此产生的解决办法既简单又有效。
我们不是像LACT[77]中那样完全用TTT快重的MLP来取代交叉视图的注意,而是重新使用TTT来从交叉视图注意的输入-输出对中明确学习.
因此,我们不再需要缓存KV;只储存更新的MLP快重.
因此,新视觉渲染的空间和时间复杂性与TTT相同.
我们称我们的战略为 " Test-Time Baking " (TTB),它可被视为一种通用形式的TTT.

blocks.en:
The design of our TTB layer is inspired by the TTT layer in LaCT [ 77 ] .
We remove the asymmetric QK projection and instead use a shared linear projection to produce queries and keys.
We adopt SwiGLU-MLP [ 50 ] as the fast-weight MLP architecture, and apply an additional linear layer to predict per-token learning rates.
For inner-loop optimization, we employ Muon [ 28 ] optimizer with weight normalization [ 48 ] for a predefined T T steps.
We find that using MSE as the inner-loop objective for our TTB yields better results than the unnormalized dot-product loss used in LaCT [ 77 ] ’s TTT.
We also find that learning the residual to the mapping target is easier to bake than learning the target directly.
Specifically, the final TTB update rule is:

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation details

blocks.en: We use 768 latent channels with 12 decoder blocks at patch size 8, replacing each cross-view attention with a TTB layer. We initialize our models from the corresponding DVSM [ 58 ] checkpoint. We use AdamW [ 38 ] with cosine annealing and perceptual loss weight λ = 0.2 \lambda=0.2 . Models are trained on DL3DV-10K [ 35 ] dataset with 64 A100 GPUs. We first train at 340p for 100 100 K iterations with learning rate × 10 − 4 4\!\times\!10^{-4} , then finetune at 480p, 720p, and 960p for 10 10 K iterations each with learning rate × 10 − 5 1\!\times\!10^{-5} . We randomly sample either 16 16 or 32 32 context views per scene with the same number of target views. Ablations use a smaller setup on 8 8 A100 GPUs at patch size 16 16 truncated to 720p, with efficiency metrics still reported at patch size 8 8 for consistency. For evaluation, we use the 140 140 held-out DL3DV testing scenes and follow previous view sampling [ 12 ] .

blocks.en: TTB layer. We use a single-headed fast-weight SwiGLU-MLP [ 50 ] with a hidden dimension of 3072 3072 , a 4 × 4\times expansion of the model dimension. The fast weight is updated with the Muon optimizer [ 28 ] and we run T = 3 T\!=\!3 inner-loop update steps. The inner-loop objective maps context-rendering tokens to the cross-view attention output of context-ground-truth tokens with the MSE loss. Fast-weight local-duplicate inference (Sec. 3.3.4 ) is turned off except stated otherwise. When enabled, we set B = 16 B{=}16 . DL3DV. Tab. 1 and Fig. 5 report results on DL3DV with 16, 32, and 64 input views at 960p.
TTB substantially closes the quality gap between DVSM [ 58 ] and LaCT [ 77 ] while rendering at a constant 23 FPS, up to 23 × 23\times faster than DVSM and 2.3 × 2.3\times faster than LaCT.
Our model is built on DVSM with 12 blocks while LaCT uses 24 blocks (model size in Tab. 3 ).
The Ours– without cross-view attention is comparable to LaCT quality with less parameters and faster rendering. With local-duplicate inference (Sec. 3.3.4 ), Ours (duplicate) further closes the residual gap at large V V and approaches DVSM quality at the same rendering speed.
Fig. 5 confirms these trends qualitatively, where TTB preserves thin and high-frequency structures such as handrails, window grilles, and small text that LaCT and LVSM [ 25 ] render with visible blur.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: From TTT to TTB. Tab. 4 decomposes the gap between a vanilla LaCT-style TTT replacement [ 77 ] and our full TTB into three additive components: context pairing, switching to MSE with T = 3 T{=}3 inner steps (yielding TTB–), and replacing the linear-projection target with cross-view attention output. Each contributes meaningfully, and stacking all three closes the quality gap to DVSM [ 58 ] while retaining TTT’s ∼ 50 \sim\!50 FPS rendering. The reconstruction cost grows quadratically with V V due to the in-loop cross-view attention, consistent with our reconstruction time for rendering quality trade-off.
blocks.zh: 从TTT到TTB. Tab. 4将香草LACT风格的TT替换[77]和我们的TTB完全分解为三个添加剂成分:上下文对接,用T=3 TQQ3内步切换到MSE(出TTB−),用交叉视图的注意输出来取代线性投影目标. 每一个都做出有意义的贡献,堆放所有三个都把质量差距缩小到DVSM[58],同时保留了TTT的 QQ 50\sim\! 50 FPS渲染. 重建费用与V相比四倍地增长,这是由于我们进行质量取舍的重建时间在不时进行交叉观察。

blocks.en: Inner-loop optimization. Tab. 6 ablates the inner-loop loss and number of update steps T T . Switching from LaCT’s unnormalized dot-product loss [ 77 ] to MSE consistently improves quality for both TTT and TTB–, with TTB– benefiting more ( + 0.44 +0.44 vs + 0.27 +0.27 PSNR). Increasing T T brings monotonic but diminishing gains, leading us to adopt T = 3 T{=}3 with MSE as a sweet spot between quality and reconstruction cost. This asymmetric response aligns with our light field view—TTB’s inner loop fits a target function and benefits from convergence, while TTT-KVB is closer to a one-shot linear write.
blocks.zh: 内出类拔萃. Tab. 6 消除了内出水损失以及更新步骤 T T 的数量 。 从LACT的非常态点产品损失[77] 切换到MSE持续改善TTT和TTB的质量,TTB受益更多(+0.44+0.44对+0.27+0.27 PSNR). 增加TT带来单调但逐渐减少的收益,导致我们采用T=3TQQ3,将MSE作为质量和重建成本之间的甜点. 这种不对称的反应与我们的光域视图一致——TTB的内环符合目标函数和趋同的好处,而TTT-KVB更接近一发直线写.

blocks.en: TTB layer design. Tab. 6 ablates two design choices in our TTB layer. Residual learning reformulates the inner-loop target from the absolute cross-view attention output to its residual against X ( ctx-rend ) X^{(\text{ctx-rend})} , reducing the magnitude of the regression target and easing the few-step inner-loop optimization. Feedback additionally applies the baked MLP to update the context ground-truth tokens, so that all three token streams propagate through identical operators in subsequent layers. Both designs contribute roughly equally in isolation ( + 0.43 +0.43 and + 0.44 +0.44 PSNR) and combine to + 0.52 +0.52 .

blocks.en:
Limitations. TTB is constrained by the fixed capacity of its fast-weight MLP, causing quality to saturate at large V V ; the local-duplicate routing that mitigates this is a heuristic, and learning it during training is left for future work.
Its inner-loop cross-view attention also makes reconstruction quadratic in V V , a drawback for single-shot scenarios.
Finally, TTB is built on reconstruction rather than generation, interpolating within context views without extrapolating to unobserved viewpoints.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present Test-Time Baking (TTB), which retargets the TTT inner-loop optimization from raw value tokens to cross-view attention outputs, turning the fast-weight MLP from a replacement for attention into its collaborator. Combined with a context pair that resolves the reconstruction-rendering modality misalignment, TTB bakes DVSM-level scene information into a fixed-size MLP while retaining TTT-level rendering complexity. Across DL3DV, Re10K, and in-the-wild benchmarks, TTB matches DVSM [ 58 ] quality at a constant 23 FPS and consistently surpasses LaCT [ 77 ] . We hope this baking perspective offers a new way to integrate attention and TTT beyond view synthesis.
blocks.zh: 我们提出Test-Time Baking(TTB),它将TTT内放优化从原始值符号重新定位到交叉视图的注意力输出,将快重的MLP从注意力取而代之转变为其合作者. TTB结合了解决重建-移交模式错配的上下文对子,将DVSM级场景信息烘烤成固定大小的MLP,同时保留了TTT级渲染的复杂性. 在整个DL3DV,Re10K,以及万能基准中,TTB与DVSM[58]质量相匹配,恒定23个FPS,并始终超过LACT[77]. 我们希望这种烘焙视角能提供一种新的方法,将注意力和TTT综合起来。

blocks.en: Appendix B Discussion: comparison with related methods
blocks.zh: 讨论:与相关方法的比较

blocks.en:
This section positions TTB within the recent landscape of feed-forward novel-view synthesis (NVS) and 3D reconstruction methods.
We focus on the LVSM family [ 25 , 58 , 22 , 77 ] together with three recent methods that adopt either TTT layers (LongLRM [ 12 ] , tttLRM [ 63 ] ) or a 3D-pretrained encoder (LagerNVS [ 61 ] ), since these are the closest design points to TTB.
The discussion is structured around three axes: training settings (Sec. B.1 ), reconstruction/rendering complexity (Sec. B.2 ), and architectural composition (Sec. B.3 ).
blocks.zh:
本节将TTB定位在最近饲料前卫小说-视野合成(NVS)和3D重建方法的地貌之内.
我们侧重于LVSM家族[25,58,22,77],以及采用TTT分层(LongLRM [12],ttLRM [63])或3D预装编码器(LagerNVS [61])的三种近期方法,因为这些是TTB最接近的设计点.
讨论围绕三个轴心进行:培训环境(Sec.B.1),重建/交付的复杂性(Sec.B.2)和建筑组成(Sec.B.3)。

blocks.en: B.1 Training settings across methods
blocks.zh: B.1 跨方法的培训环境

blocks.en:
Tab. 7 compares the training data, compute, and pretraining source across baselines and our method.
All listed methods share AdamW as the outer-loop optimizer and a multi-stage resolution curriculum, so we restrict the table to the three axes that most directly affect comparability.

blocks.en:
The compute footprint ( 64 × 64{\times} A100) is broadly shared across the group when reported, so the differences mainly lie in data composition and pretraining strategy.
Most LVSM-family methods train scene-only on Re10K or DL3DV, occasionally extending to Objaverse for object-level pretraining; LagerNVS is the outlier that explicitly relies on a multi-dataset mixture of fifteen sources to obtain its in-the-wild generalization.
Three methods escape the from-scratch pattern, and they do so along two distinct lines: tttLRM and TTB warm-start from an NVS checkpoint of the same task family (TTT-LVSM and DVSM, respectively), reusing weights that were already optimized for novel-view rendering; LagerNVS instead transfers from VGGT, a model trained for 3D reconstruction, and jointly finetunes both the VGGT encoder and a freshly initialized cross-attention renderer with the rendering loss.
TTB sits closer to tttLRM in this taxonomy—both inherit cross-view-attention features from a pretrained NVS backbone and reshape them into a TTT-style fast-weight representation—while LagerNVS represents an orthogonal direction of leveraging 3D-supervised priors.
blocks.zh:
计算足迹(64×64{\times}A100)在被报告时被广泛共享,因此差异主要在于数据组成和预训策略.
大多数LVSM-family方法只在Re10K或DL3DV上训练场景,偶尔会延伸至Objaverse进行对象级别预训;LagerNVS是明确依赖由15个来源组成的多数据集混合物来得到其被闪烁通俗化的外接器.
三种方法摆脱了从scratch模式,它们按照两种不同的思路进行: tttLRM和TTB从同一个任务家族(分别为TT-LVSM和DVSM)的NVS检查站起暖起动,重用已经优化后用于新视觉渲染的重量; LagerNVS转而从VGGT转出,这是为3D重建而训练的模型,并联合微调了VGGT编码器和与渲染损失一起被新初始化的交叉意向渲染器.
TTB在这个分类学中坐得更接近tttLRM——既继承了被预先训练的NVS主干部的交叉取景特征,又将其重塑为TTT式快重代表,而LagerNVS代表了利用由3D监督的前身的正统取向.

The table makes the design space explicit.
The decoder-only LVSM reconstructs nothing offline and pays the full attention cost at every novel-view query; LVSM enc.-dec. and Efficient-LVSM amortize the cost into a one-time encoding stage but the rendering cost remains linear in the number of context tokens.
DVSM further removes the encoder-decoder decoupling but at the price of quadratic cross-view attention during prefilling.
LagerNVS occupies the same asymptotic regime as LVSM enc.-dec. but with a heavier V V -dependence because its VGGT encoder runs alternating frame-wise and global self-attention over all V ⋅ L V\cdot L tokens, yielding 𝒪 ⁡ ( V 2 ⋅ L 2 ) \mathcal{O}(V^{2}\cdot L^{2}) encoding and 𝒪 ⁡ ( V ⋅ L ) \mathcal{O}(V\cdot L) per-token rendering through cross-attention to the encoder output.
LaCT pushes both axes to their constant-complexity limits via TTT layers, whereas TTB occupies a previously empty cell on this map: it preserves DVSM’s quadratic reconstruction cost—necessary because cross-view attention provides the inner-loop target—while inheriting LaCT’s 𝒪 ⁡ ( 1 ) \mathcal{O}(1) rendering and fixed-size scene representation.
TTB– in turn shows that, when the cross-view attention target is replaced by a linear projection, reconstruction collapses back to linear in V V , recovering LaCT’s complexity profile but with the rest of the TTB design choices retained.
LRM-style baselines such as LongLRM and tttLRM occupy a different regime altogether, since their per-scene state is an explicit 3D Gaussian set rendered by a rasterizer rather than a neural module; we list them for completeness but do not directly compare 𝒪 \mathcal{O} -rendering with them.

blocks.en:
A consistent pattern across the methods is a 24 24 -block decoder for from-scratch models, while methods that initialize from a pretrained backbone are able to reduce decoder depth.
DVSM and our method use a 12 12 -block decoder by sharing weights between reconstruction and rendering stages; LagerNVS reaches the same 12 12 -block decoder width and depth ( 768 768 , 12 12 blocks) by offloading representational capacity to a 24 24 -block, 1024 1024 -dim VGGT encoder.
TTB inherits the 12 12 -block depth directly from DVSM: every TTB layer additionally houses a fast-weight MLP whose inner loop is supervised by the cross-view attention output, but the surrounding intra-view attention and FFN sublayers are unchanged from DVSM.
The net effect is that TTB matches or surpasses both 24 24 -block from-scratch baselines and the much heavier LagerNVS on DL3DV (main paper Tab. 1 , Tab. 3 ) while operating with comparable parameter counts to DVSM ( 244 244 M for TTB– and 271 271 M for TTB, against 163 163 M for DVSM, 379 379 M for LaCT, and over 1 1 B for LagerNVS due to the included VGGT encoder).
We attribute this efficiency to the combination of a shallow shared decoder and the inheritance of pretrained DVSM weights, which Sec. A.2 discusses in detail.

LagerNVS通过在重建阶段和渲染阶段之间分享权重,使用12个12-块的解码器; LagerNVS通过卸载代表容量到24个24-块,1024个1024个-dim VGGT编码器,达到同样的12个12-块的解码器宽度和深度(768 768个,12个12个12个区块).
TTB直接从DVSM继承了12个12-块的深度:每个TTB层外加一个快重的MLP,其内环由交叉视图的注意力输出监督,但周围的视野内注意力和FFN子层与DVSM没有变化.
净效应是,TTB与DL3DV(主要纸张Tab. 1, Tab. 3)的24个24-24个区块和DL3DV(主要纸张Tab. 1, Tab. 3)上的LagerNVS在使用与DVSM可比的参数计数时相匹配或超过(TTTB为244 244 M,TTTB为271 M,而DVSM为163 163 M,LACT为379 379 M,由于包含VGGT编码器,LagerNVS为1 B以上)。

blocks.en: Appendix E Broader impacts
blocks.zh: 附录E 更广泛的影响

blocks.en:
TTB shares its broader impacts with feed-forward novel-view synthesis methods in general.
What is more specific to TTB is the methodological perspective it offers: rather than replacing attention with a test-time-trained fast-weight MLP as in prior TTT-style architectures, TTB shows that the fast-weight MLP can be supervised to collaborate with attention by baking its outputs into a constant-size state.
This baking perspective is potentially applicable beyond novel-view synthesis, in any setting where a powerful but expensive attention module needs to be amortized into a state of fixed size.
Long-context language models, where attention KV-caches grow linearly with sequence length, could similarly benefit from baking attention outputs into a fixed-capacity fast weight to enable constant-memory inference.
World models and video generators that maintain a long temporal context face the same memory-growth issue and may adopt analogous baking strategies for the temporal-attention component.
Physical 3D perception systems that operate on streaming sensor inputs, such as embodied agents and autonomous driving stacks, could likewise use a baked fast-weight state to maintain a compact running memory of the environment without unbounded KV growth.
We hope the baking perspective inspires further exploration of how attention and test-time training can be combined across these domains.
blocks.zh:
TTB与总的饲料向上小说视角合成方法分享其更广泛的影响.
TTB更具体的是它提供的方法视角:TTB不是像之前的TTT式建筑那样,用测试时间训练的快重MLP来取而代之,TTB显示快重的MLP可以通过将输出烘焙成常态来监督配合.
这种烘焙视角在新颖视角综合之外,在任何需要将强大而昂贵的注意单元分期摊还到固定大小状态的情况下,都有可能适用。
长结文字语言模型,即注意力KV-caches随着序列长度而线性地增长,同样可以从将注意力输出烘焙成固定容量快重来使常数推论成为可能.
世界模型和视频生成器保持较长的时间背景,面临同样的记忆增长问题,可能对时间注意部分采取类似的烘焙战略。
在流式传感器输入上运行的物理3D感知系统,如内含物剂和自发驱动堆栈,同样可以使用烘焙快重状态来保持紧凑的运行环境内存而不受无约束的KV生长.
我们希望,烘焙观点能激励人们进一步探索如何将注意力和试验时间培训结合起来。
